sources.title: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct repository identifies Meta, Llama 3.1, nominal 8B size, text input/output, 128k context, GQA and downloadable weights under llama3.1. Its tool-use section documents native structured tool calls. Reopened October 27: the developer card explicitly includes instruction-tuned 8B models and lists 8B in its Params table.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: The original Llama 3.1 license explicitly dates the version to July 23, 2024 and grants limited use, modification and redistribution rights subject to its terms.

sources.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models, version 3
sources.evidence: Table 1 separately labels Llama 3.1 8B Instruct as finetuned, multilingual, long-context and tool-capable in July 2024, distinct from original Llama 3. The paper states its results concern 3.1. Section 3.2 specifies dense Transformers; Table 3 gives 8B: 32 layers, width 4096, FFN 14336, 32 attention heads and 8 KV heads. Reopened October 27: introduction and architecture table retain the nominal 8B size for the Llama 3.1 model; no distinct activated-count specification was located in the checked Meta sections.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 prompt formats
sources.evidence: Original Instruct protocol defines system/user/assistant/ipython roles, python_tag and eom_id tool handoff, built-in tools and custom JSON/function calls. It documents ordinary assistant responses and tool interaction, without a dedicated thinking switch or separate reasoning channel.

sources.title: Meta model SKU types and maximum sequence length
sources.evidence: Explicitly maps CoreModelId.llama3_1_8b_instruct to ModelFamily.llama3_1; max_seq_length returns 131072 for that family, versus 8192 for original Llama 3.

sources.title: Meta Llama model SKU definitions
sources.evidence: llama3_1_instruct_models directly maps the 8B Instruct SKU to meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and gives its 32-layer, 4096-dimensional, 32-query-head and 8-KV-head architecture.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 evaluation details
sources.evidence: ZeroSCROLLS specifies the post-trained Llama prompt limit as 131072 minus generated tokens, explicitly contrasting non-Llama models at 128000. Other long-context evaluations also reach 131072.

sources.title: Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date
sources.evidence: July 23, 2024 announcement releases upgraded 8B and 70B models alongside 405B, with weights available for download that day, longer context, multilingual dialogue and tool use.

sources.title: Exact model public repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public metadata identifies LlamaForCausalLM, the original model lineage, tool-aware chat template and BF16 safetensors aggregate of 8030261248 elements. This aggregate is not used as a verified precise learned-parameter count without tensor/tying/buffer reconciliation.

sources.title: Exact original model configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated direct request returned HTTP 401. No gated configuration or weights were retrieved; exact context is independently established by public Meta implementation and evaluation documentation.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 18 and Section 4.6
sources.evidence: Freshly checked October 27: Table 18 explicitly identifies LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and lists Dense architecture, 8B Activated Params and 8B Total Params. Section 4.6 separately names this exact Instruct model among the non-thinking comparison baselines. This is the Qwen research team's nominal benchmark counting convention, not an active-count disclosure by Meta; it does not establish an exact component-level per-token census. The current HTML labels this Table 18, not Table 16.

name.note: Exact official repository name; distinguished from Llama 3 and the pretrained 3.1 base model.

family.note: Llama family; the specific generation is Llama 3.1.

release_date.note: Original license gives the release day; the dated announcement confirms public downloads began that day.

open_weights.note: Original trained weights are distributed under the Llama 3.1 Community License; custom terms and access gating do not mean closed weights.

license.note: Custom Llama 3.1 license, not the original Llama 3 license or Apache/MIT.

parameters_b.note: Meta reports a nominal 8B size for the exact Llama 3.1 8B Instruct model. Reopened model card and technical report confirm this published precision; retain 8B without requiring an exact learned-tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Qwen3 Table 18 explicitly lists 8B activated parameters for LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct; Section 4.6 confirms the exact comparison variant. Adopt Qwen Team's published nominal benchmark convention, not an inference from dense architecture or a Meta disclosure. Exact per-token component participation is not established.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive Transformer, with GQA: 32 query heads and 8 key/value heads across 32 layers. The v3 paper explicitly scopes its results to Llama 3.1.

context_window.note: Meta maps the exact Instruct SKU to 131072 maximum sequence length. Evaluation instructions explicitly distinguish 131072 Llama tokens from 128000 for other models; this is the combined prompt/generation budget.

modalities.note: This released Instruct checkpoint is text-only. Code output is text; unreleased multimodal experiments in the paper are not this model.

reasoning.note: The model supports reasoning tasks and CoT prompting, but the original protocol/card/template do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode or explicitly exclude one. Clear the unsupported baseline false rather than conflate reasoning performance with a mode flag.

tool_call.note: Exact Table 1 Instruct row and official protocol establish native tool support, including python_tag/eom_id handoffs and custom structured calls; a host executes the call.

description.value: Meta open-weight 8B Llama 3.1 instruction-tuned text model for multilingual dialogue and tool use.
description.note: Replace unsupported qualitative lightweight/drafting wording with the documented model scope and capabilities.

patch.description: Meta open-weight 8B Llama 3.1 instruction-tuned text model for multilingual dialogue and tool use.
patch.notes: Meta reports a nominal 8B total. Qwen3 Table 18 reports 8B activated parameters for this exact Instruct model under Qwen Team's benchmark convention; this is not a separate Meta disclosure or exact per-token census. Dense GQA model with 131072-token context and native tool calls; a dedicated reasoning mode remains undisclosed.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retained Meta's nominal 8B total and established a nominal 8B active count from the original Qwen3 research comparison, Table 18 and Section 4.6, which explicitly identifies Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. The active count follows Qwen Team's stated benchmark convention; Meta's checked original sources do not separately define it, and exact per-token component participation remains unestablished. Reopened the Meta card and Llama technical report and searched for missed parameter disclosures. Preserved the other twelve field assessments, including dense GQA architecture, 131072-token context, native tools and the unresolved dedicated reasoning-mode flag.
